non_blocking_observations.observation: Each attempt is one async in-page evaluation. The initiating Radix option is mounted and enabled before the post-readiness baseline; no driver round-trip occurs, and no await or yield separates the in-flight observation from replacement dispatch. Replacements use already-mounted toolbar controls, never a second Select option.

The protocol is feasible with current Radix and React behavior. Select options can activate through their real click/pointer/keyboard handlers and close the portal. The toolbar zoom and fit buttons are outside that portal and remain mounted. Observing generation-1 renderStart requires React to have committed the initiating state, so synchronous replacement handlers use the current 200%/300% state and enqueue genuine second generations targeting 210%, fit-page, and 310%.
